identity.description: Sources describe NMI's white-label payment gateway and developer APIs (the hint says Paygent is NMI-powered). Sources do not mention 'Paygent Connect' by name.
identity.identity_notes: Sources cover NMI (Network Merchants) docs only; none mention Paygent or Paygent Connect, so the link is based only on the assignment hint.

auth.oauth_flows: An OAuth access token endpoint exists (POST, token valid 60 minutes); grant type not specified.
auth.token_refresh: OAuth access tokens are valid for 60 minutes; request a new token after expiry.
auth.scopes_notes: API keys are public (client-side) or private (server-side) and inherit permissions from the associated user. The OAuth token endpoint lists scopes.

access.production_restrictions: Not established. Keys are created in the Merchant Portal or Partner Portal; sources do not say how those accounts are obtained.

api.rate_limits: Rate limits are rare. Payment API returns response_code 301; system-wide limit returns HTTP 429.
api.limitations: Some Classic APIs (transact.php) authenticate with the API key in the request body.
